commerce.explainer: An empty field inherits the hotel value. Zero means “no fee” — that is different.

inclusions.executorHint: This choice drives both order routing and whose schedule applies

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: What is happening now. Period totals live in Analytics.

security.subtitle: The second factor of your own account and the list of devices it was opened from. You come here when access may have reached the wrong hands — to close the extra sessions.

login.title: Root admin
login.codeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app

overview.title: Platform overview
overview.subtitle: The whole platform at a glance: how many hotels, how many orders are running right now, whether everything responds. This is the first stop — to be sure nothing stalled overnight.

field.name: Name
field.languagesHint: Codes separated by commas. The first one is the default.
field.subdomainWhy: The subdomain is the hotel key and is printed on room QR codes: changing it would turn them into junk.

hotel.activeOff: Disabled — storefront and CMS are closed
hotel.adminHint: Creates or resets access. The password is emailed to the hotel admin — the operator never sees it.
hotel.limitHint: Going over does not switch the hotel off — the platform decides.
hotel.modulesHint: An enabled module appears in the hotel CMS; a disabled one is hidden. A manual decision survives a tariff change: what you switched off stays off, and what was enabled beyond the tariff goes dark if the new tariff does not include it.
hotel.tariffHint: The plan is set by hand.
hotel.tariffNoMoney: This is a record, not a payment: no money moves here.
hotel.readOnly: Editing the profile is available to the owner and support roles.
hotel.adminMoveHint: For when the old mailbox is lost: the address changes without sending anything, and the password reset then goes to the new one.

intro.modules: Which features this hotel has on and where each came from — the tariff or a manual override. You come here to switch a feature on beyond the tariff, or to take it away.
intro.activity: What happened at the hotel: guest orders, app entries, calls to room equipment. You come here when a hotel complains and you need to see what actually took place.
intro.support: When platform staff entered this hotel under someone else’s account, and why. You come here to cut off that access or to tell the hotel who was inside.
intro.tariff: Which tariff the hotel is on, how much it has already used, and what changes if it moves. You come here when a hotel hits a limit and asks for more, and at renewal.
intro.data: An export of everything the hotel has accumulated, and its shutdown with data erasure. You come here when a hotel leaves the platform or demands its data by law.

hotel.limitWontFit: does not fit the selected tariff

admins.title: Hotel administrators
admins.hint: Who signs in to this hotel’s CMS. An extra administrator is usually a typo in the address.
admins.lastHint: The last one cannot be revoked: the hotel would lose access to its CMS.
admins.existing: The hotel already has an administrator: {{list}}. Check the address — a second full admin is usually a typo.

create.title: New hotel
create.name: Name
create.doneHint: The hotel sets itself up from here in its CMS.
create.donePasswordSent: Password sent to the administrator at {{email}}

modules.title: Modules & plans
modules.subtitle: What each tariff opens and what is switched on beyond it. You come here when a hotel asks for a feature it does not have — to see whether the tariff covers it.
modules.note: A plan opens a set of modules; a single hotel can be given a feature off-plan — a pilot, for instance. An enabled module appears in the hotel CMS, a disabled one is hidden. Downgrading below current usage is flagged and needs a decision.

nodes.title: On-premise
nodes.subtitle: Servers standing inside the hotels themselves. Needed where room control or the hotel management system (PMS) is on: the cloud cannot reach equipment inside the building.
nodes.empty: No servers yet. They appear at hotels with room control or a hotel management system (PMS).
nodes.reissueWarning: Reissue the key for node “{{name}}”? The old key stops working immediately; the connector will reconnect with the new one.

team.title: Platform team
team.subtitle: Who can reach /admin
team.empty: You are the only one on the platform team so far.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: Every platform action — who, what, when

enter.title: Enter “{{hotel}}”
enter.hint: Opens the hotel CMS on behalf of the platform. A reason is required, the session expires, everything is audited.
enter.audited: Every action in this session is marked as a support edit.

templates.title: Templates & dictionaries
templates.subtitle: The blanks a new hotel is assembled from: a set of venues and the lists of allergens and markers shared by everyone. You come here before creating a hotel — to check what it will open with.
templates.noServices: No services — the hotel adds its own
templates.note: A template only sets the START. It is not tied to the hotel: editing it later changes nothing for hotels already created.
templates.dictNote: A hotel gets its own copy on creation and may deactivate entries. Edits here reach new hotels.
templates.dictEmpty: The dictionary is empty so far.
templates.dictIntro: The reference lists of allergens and markers, shared across the platform. Every new hotel receives a COPY and edits it on its own side: a change here reaches only hotels created after it.

data.exportHint: Hand the hotel its data. Reversible, can be done any number of times.
data.offboardHint: Stopping processing. Two steps: marking disables the hotel, erasure is irreversible.
data.marked: Hotel marked for shutdown and switched off.
data.deleteTitle: Remove the hotel from the registry
data.deleteHint: Data is erased by the shutdown; this is about the hotel itself: it leaves the lists, the address is freed and becomes available again. The row stays soft-deleted: the platform must still be able to answer that the hotel existed.
data.deleted: Hotel “{{subdomain}}” removed, the name is free

support.title: Support sessions
support.subtitle: Active platform staff sessions inside hotels. A revoked session dies on the very next request.
support.empty: No one is inside any hotel right now.

errors.http: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have rights for this action.

roomControl.title: Room control

import.title: Import variables
import.hint: Commissioning file with commands and feedback channels. The import creates technical variables only — you build the interface yourself.

warning.command_without_feedback: Command without feedback — nothing to confirm it with
warning.feedback_without_command: Feedback without a command — read-only parameter
warning.unexpected_structure: File structure differs from the expected one

reconcile.title: Hardware check
reconcile.hint: Excel is a variable map, not the truth. The check reads the reference room and shows discrepancies.
reconcile.extra_on_server: Present on hardware but missing from the file
reconcile.notBlocking: The check could not run. You can still save the import.

builder.title: Interface builder
builder.hiddenHint: This element is not bound to any variable. Guests will not see it.
builder.variablesHint: Came from the import. A map of hardware channels, not the guest screen.
builder.noVariablesHint: Import the commissioning workbook — the builder needs something to build from.
builder.bindHint: Guests only see bound elements: a capability without a variable is a promise with nobody behind it.
builder.overrideHint: If one room is named differently on the hardware, set the device name for that room alone — without touching the type template.

check.title: Test on a room
check.no_feedback_channel: Sent. The channel has no feedback — nothing to confirm
check.feedback_dead: Command accepted, but feedback did not change. This is the stand's state, not a configuration error
check.hint: The run goes to real hardware. With no value it only reads — nothing is switched in an occupied room.
check.nothingBound: Nothing to check: no element is bound to variables

publish.title: Publishing
publish.nothingToPublish: Nothing to publish: no element is bound to a variable
publish.hint: Edits reach the guest only through publishing. A rollback restores the whole snapshot, plan markup included.
publish.noVersionsHint: Assemble the screen in the builder and publish it.

roomControl.subtitle: What a guest will be able to switch in their room: lights, curtains, climate, scenes. You come here once when the hotel launches, and later when equipment on site changes.
roomControl.noTypesHint: Start by importing the commissioning workbook on the Import tab.

access.demoTitle: Demo entry without a PIN — for the whole hotel
access.pinHint: The PIN is shown once — when it is issued. Changing it clears confirmation on every device of that room.
access.noPins: No room has a PIN yet
access.intro: Which guests may control the room: by the stay PIN or by the room number alone. You come here at launch and on a complaint that a neighbour controls someone’s room.
access.demoHint: Not a room setting: the relaxation applies to every room at once and stays on until someone turns it off.
access.pinMuted: PINs are not being asked for right now: demo entry is on. You can still issue a code — it starts working once the relaxation is switched off.

plan.framesHint: One lit frame is enough: the server computes the night frame, and it lines up by construction. Your own pair is accepted too — it is checked for alignment.

night.failed: The night frame was not computed — the plate will fall back to a mask

pair.unreadable: The file does not read as an image
pair.no_structure: No walls or furniture are visible in the frame
pair.not_aligned: The frames were shot from different points — furniture will double at the zone edge

plan.pairHint: Upload the lit frame alone — the night frame is computed from it and matches pixel for pixel.
plan.needPublish: Nothing to bind zones to yet: publish the type configuration and the elements will appear in the list.
plan.inspectorHint: Pick a shape on the plan or draw a new one with the tools above.
plan.controlHint: The list holds the published elements of this type.
plan.featherHint: How far the light spills past the zone walls. Shared by every zone of the frame.
plan.copyHint: Only the geometry travels: every type has its own frame.
plan.rectOnly: Zones are rectangular. Cover an irregular room with a larger rectangle, or split it into two zones.
plan.baking: Lit frame uploaded, night frame is being computed
plan.noFrame: There is no plan frame yet — upload a lit frame above.
plan.previewNeedsNight: The light preview will show the difference once the night frame is ready.
plan.extinguishHint: The night frame is computed from the lit one: lighting is removed, and the lamps themselves are dimmed separately — by the «brighter than surroundings» test. On a light render that test does not trigger and the lamps stay lit. Switch this off and shoot the night frame separately instead.

diagnostics.recheckImpossible: Nothing to re-read: the entry has no element or room
diagnostics.truncated: Showing the latest {{limit}} entries. Narrow the range or filters to see the rest.
diagnostics.emptyHint: Commands and reads for this hotel will appear here — with the hardware response and the reason for failure.

homeBlocks.title: Home screen
homeBlocks.hint: What the guest sees first: weather with local time and their room state.
homeBlocks.weatherNeedsPoint: Set the hotel coordinates — without them there is no weather
homeBlocks.roomStatusHint: The same pills as on the room screen; tapping opens it
homeBlocks.timezoneHint: The home screen clock and venue schedules are computed from it
homeBlocks.hotelNameHint: Shown to the guest on every screen. Keep the proper name as it is in all languages — translate the word around it («hotel», «resort»).

search.title: Guest search
search.hint: What takes part in results and what the guest sees in an empty field.

state.crashed: This screen failed to open because of a data error. The rest of the console works.

access.cmsBody: Your role has no access to management sections. Your work lives on the order board.

modulePending.body: The module is connected, but its settings screen is still being built. It will open right here once it ships.

sessions.title: My sign-ins
sessions.hint: Devices this account is open on.
sessions.logoutAllHint: Closes every session, including this one. Use it if access may have leaked.

list.nothingFoundHint: No records match the current search and filters.
